places.name: Katsushika Hokusai's Birthplace
places.connection: Hokusai was born in Edo, which is present-day Tokyo.

places.name: Hokusai's Studio in Edo
places.connection: Hokusai created the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series in his studio in Edo.

places.name: Sumida Hokusai Museum
places.connection: The museum houses a collection of Hokusai's works, including pieces from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji.

places.name: Mount Fuji
places.connection: Mount Fuji is the central subject depicted in the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series.

places.name: Nagoya Castle
places.connection: Nagoya Castle is depicted in one of the prints from the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series.
